page.content:
Automated copyright-matching system that claims or mutes reused audio and video.

How Content ID connects

  • Topic: Copyright strike — Content ID claims sit beside strikes as YouTube's copyright machinery.
  • Work: YouTube Poop — Content ID and strikes hemmed in the wildest YouTube Poop remix years.

What is Content ID?

Content ID fingerprints uploads against a rights-holder database, the industrial answer to the copyright fights that followed Google's purchase.
